records.text: A student who carried out a shooting at Mid-Peninsula High School in 1996 had been working with Philip Bliss for depression
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: He installs himself as the principal of that school, and that school then has a shooting. In 1996, it turns out that the student that committed the shooting had been working with Philip Bliss through his depression.
